exposure: Menstrual cycle phase (menses, late follicular, early luteal, late luteal)
niche in the uterine caesarean section scar
cohort: Women with a niche in the uterine caesarean section scar compared with controls without a caesarean section scar
finding: The amplitude of subendometrial contractions was significantly higher in women with a niche in the caesarean section scar compared with controls without a previous caesarean section.
mod_finding: This study focuses on the impact of caesarean section scars on uterine contractions but does not directly compare outcomes based on mode of delivery.
